Sources/DemoRecorderKit/RecorderOptions.swift: explicitly select HEVC or H.264; unsupported requested codec settings fail
Sources/DemoRecorderKit/CadenceWriter.swift: separate cadence producer and encoder; preserve collected frame timestamps through bounded backpressure; drain GPU copies and encoder before finalization

Sources/DemoRecorderKit/MetalFrameCopier.swift: Metal-only deep copies into a bounded compatible pixel buffer pool; retain source and destination buffers and CVMetalTexture wrappers until GPU completion; fail on GPU or shutdown errors
Sources/DemoRecorderKit/BoundedFrameQueue.swift: enforce capacity, monotonic timestamps, ordered acknowledgement and producer shutdown
Sources/DemoRecorderKit/CadenceAccounting.swift: distinguish skipped producer slots from rejected frames
Sources/DemoRecorderKit/DisplayRecorder.swift: pass the requested codec into the writer
Tests/RecorderTests/RecorderTests.swift: explicit codecs, cadence accounting, backpressure, ordering, queue bounds, shutdown, actual Metal pixels and GPU resource lifetime

Sources/HostRecorder/HostRecorder.swift: capture the complete native-pixel viewport of one verified owned VM window on the host; retain real host cursor, source geometry, first-frame clock and executable hash; finalize on guest story completion

Sources/RecorderRelay/RecorderRelay.swift: synchronize host camera with guest narration using measured direct TCP clock round trips before and after the take; reject excessive uncertainty/drift and copy only finalized camera evidence

Sources/HostMouseRelay/HostMouseRelay.swift: authenticated, peer-restricted native host mouse input mapped into the owned VM view, per-event frame/focus validation, immediate clock responses and sanitized input traces
